lines.text: Do not have to, not must not!
Many learners say: You must not bring a gift.
Better: You do not have to bring a gift.
Not needed? Say do not have to.
Do not have to! You do not have to bring a gift.

data.wrong: You must not bring a gift.
data.right: You do not have to bring a gift.
data.why: Not needed? Say do not have to.

quiz.stem: You ___ bring a gift. It is not needed.

native.tip: „Sie müssen nicht kommen“ heißt „You do not have to come“. „Must not“ bedeutet „nicht dürfen“.
